title: final.rule.json
description: Sidecar written beside a QorTime final. Not a receipt.v0 field and not under schema/**. Pages does not publish docs/design. The page shows the referee's file when the review wrote one, otherwise the client's file. When both exist and the scores differ, the page shows the referee score and a visible note of the client's score. Absence of both does not fail verification. $id is a URN until this schema is published.

posted_score.description: Score written on an unconfirmed final. The terminal score of the longest componentwise non-decreasing chain of locks. When several longest chains share that score, it is this score. When their terminal scores differ, this is null and neither chain end is written.

writer.description: client when the capture tail wrote the file. referee when the official re-read wrote it.

cutoff_ms.description: Null is not one meaning. Read cutoff_reason.

cutoff_reason.description: no_end_screen: cutoff_ms is null and no evidence row counts. closed_episodes_only: cutoff_ms is null and evidence outside the closed bands counts. open_episode: cutoff_ms is the integer cutoff of the episode that is still open.

episode_e0_ms.description: First end screen of the open episode, including a screen whose timestamp equals the closing lock. An integer when cutoff_reason is open_episode. Null when cutoff_reason is no_end_screen or closed_episodes_only. Not the first end screen of the capture.

evidence_counted.description: Audit list. The only consumer of the evidence cutoff. The publisher does not render it. It does not change final_confirmed.
